decisions.reason: The accepted option necessarily makes random no-referral ticket assignment depend on a user-triggered separate finalization transaction rather than an automatic follow-up transaction.

value_updates.random_no_referral_finalization: For a no-code mint with a detected VRF request, the user must select a manual Finalize random referral button in the success modal to execute the separate finalization transaction; it must not open automatically.

decisions.reason: The accepted option changes how random-referral finalization is initiated in the success modal, but it does not change which NFT metadata attributes must be displayed or their required accuracy.
